name: Cool Boy
main_effect:
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [Royal Knight] trait, by suspending this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with the [Royal Knight] trait would leave the battle area, you may play 1 [Omekamon] from your hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
